endorsements.name: Kyle Yang
endorsements.label: The Endless Game, Fighting Against Kelihos Botnet
endorsements.description: Kelihos is still alive even after the 2nd take down action, building its p2p infrastructure and sending spam again. It bounced back after 2nd take down operation in couple of hours. In the recent Kelihos build, it implemented a brand new custom encryption algorithm(270+ layer custom encryption) and remove the BitCoin mining function. This raises numerous questions:Did it survive in the 2nd task down operation? How did it evolve? Is there any changes in its infrastructure? Why did it remove the BitCoin mining function? What are the new functionality added in it? Is the Kelihos p2p infrastructure used by itself only?
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Middle-East 2012
